name: flow_escalates_from_ai
description: FLOWS SUITE. Caller takes the automated assistant, then decides they want a person after all. Exercises escalate_to_human OUT of a specialist, a transition no scenario has walked - every existing caller asks for a human from triage, before a specialist exists.

setup._comment: An agent is available on every queue so no branch can dead-end merely because nobody was there to take the call.

missions.label: caller starts with the assistant then wants a person
missions.persona: You are phoning a company about a product that is not working. When offered a choice of who to talk to, take the automated assistant first - you are happy to try it. Ask it about your problem. Then, after it has replied once or twice, decide that this is not getting you anywhere and say clearly that you would like to speak to a real person instead. Be polite about it but be unambiguous, and if you are asked to confirm, confirm. TERMINATION (harness hygiene, not character): if roughly 16 exchanges have gone by, or you have heard four hold announcements, say goodbye and use end_call. Never mention that you are an AI or that this is a test.
missions.post_prompt: Report the call as ONLY a raw JSON object - no prose, no markdown fences. Answer as the CALLER, honestly, including when the experience was poor. Keys exactly: mission (string, 'flow_escalates_from_ai'), started_with_the_assistant (boolean), asked_for_a_person_later (boolean), ended_up_with_a_person (boolean), reached (one of 'human','human_queue','ai_specialist','callback','still_with_receptionist','nowhere'), got_helped (boolean), misrouted (boolean - true if you ended up somewhere you had not asked for), was_talked_over (boolean), had_to_repeat_yourself (boolean), most_confusing_moment (string - one short sentence, or empty), turns (integer), notes (short string).

assertions.label: OBSERVABILITY: the caller returned a structured verdict
assertions._comment: OBSERVABILITY, deliberately soft. A missing verdict means the test could not OBSERVE the call, not that the product failed it. The platform's post-prompt on the caller-bot leg returns 'There was an problem getting a response.' intermittently (seen 2026-08-20 at 52 turns and 2026-08-21 at 25 turns, so it is not simply length). On the 2026-08-21 occurrence the product side of that same call was demonstrably fine - tool_call_names route_to_department, transfer_to_human; queue_id support; status assigned - so failing the suite on it would be blaming this codebase for a platform hiccup. The product-side hard assertions still gate the run (a transcript must exist and a handoff must have fired, so a call that never happened still fails), and run_suite.py reports no-verdict runs separately and excludes them from the friction tally, so the gap stays visible.

assertions.label: the agent's side of the call was captured
CORE: the caller reached the AI specialist first
CORE: and was then escalated out of it to a human
assertions._comment: escalate_to_human is the specialist's own exit tool. If this is absent while the caller asked for a person, the specialist is a one-way door.

assertions.label: the caller ended up with a person
the caller reached the human path
FRICTION: the caller was not sent somewhere they had not asked for
FRICTION: the caller was not talked over
FRICTION: the caller did not have to repeat themselves
NEVER: read out a long number the caller did not give
assertions._comment: Eight or more spelled-out digits in a row is a phone number being read aloud. A live call ended with 'The customer service number is plus one two zero two five five five one two three four' - an INVENTED number, given to a caller who could not find their account number and was told they could not be helped without it. Same class as quoting a product that does not exist. The threshold is 8 so that reading back a short account or order number the caller supplied does not trip it. Hard, because a caller who is already connected to the call centre never needs a number read to them.

assertions.label: NEVER: send the caller somewhere else to get help
assertions._comment: The off-ramp that accompanied the invented number: 'I recommend contacting our customer service directly. They may be able to assist you further.' The caller was ALREADY talking to the call centre. Sending them away is a dead end dressed up as help, and it is invisible in call state - the call looks completed. Regex rather than a keyword list because enumerating phrasings is the brittleness test_human_request_gate.py exists to document.
